_comment: The one contract of Ergopti Studio's « My typing » payload, read by _shared/metrics/engine/view/studio_ngrams.lua (macOS, Linux), windows/ui/layout_manager/editor_window.ahk and the worker of windows/modules/keystats/keystats_prefetch.ahk, and pinned by tools/test/test-layout-manager-page.cjs. families maps each keystats reader code to its table and payload field; the top-level fields hold the keys the fingers typed (every count minus its synthetic sources: hotstring, llm, other), and final_field names the object that holds the same families and a total with every source counted (the final text, after hotstring expansions and AI completions; schema 2). codes are the refusals the page translates as layout_editor.studio.keystats.<code>.
